charts.title: TOI-1221 b: orbits around TOI-1221
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-1221's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-1221 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Mann et al. 2023 (2023AJ....165..217M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname MANN_ET_AL__2023): P 91.68278 d

charts.title: TOI-1221 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-1221 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (96, 97, 98) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 349095149, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 30 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 42 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 32-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 30 min early; 32-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 14 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
